newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-RONALDO ARRIVES IN ITALY TO JOIN INTER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO ARRIVES IN ITALY TO JOIN INTER.

text.p: Brazilian striker Ronaldo arrived in Italy on Friday to join Internazionale Milan from Spanish club Barcelona.
His flight from Brazil touched down at Rome's Fiumicino airport at just after 6.00 a.m. (0400 GMT). He emerged smiling, hand in hand with his partner Susana Werner.
"Surprise!" he told waiting photographers. "The flight was fine and I'm pleased to be here."
Ronaldo boarded a flight to Milan and landed there at 8.00 a.m. (0600 GMT). He was due to hold a news conference at Inter headquarters at 2.30 p.m. (1230 GMT).
